title: Phase 4 slim RealBasicVSR image and bounded GPU probes
body: The slim serverless image was built from CUDA/cuDNN without the monolithic Conda base and published as nivaldo12/leaneria-runpod@sha256:20c2d4ad05e354c32137c638ba859435ef930b8afe5bcc3347679cb38dc32aae. Its unpacked size is 4,612,845,428 bytes versus 17.6 GB for the prior image, about 74 percent smaller. Torch 1.13.1+cu116, MMCV 1.7.1, RealBasicVSR imports, runner startup, and checkpoint SHA256 passed locally in the container. A RunPod health job completed after 91,345 ms delay and 163 ms execution, confirming CUDA, a 24 GB GPU and checkpoint. A 600x300 restoration job then failed at provider level without a returned artifact; provider termination/OOM is a hypothesis, not confirmed because logs were not preserved. A later 400x200 attempt timed out waiting for capacity before health. Every temporary endpoint, template and Hostear project was deleted and capacity returned to zero.
